user.title: Connect to ButterflyMX
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the ButterflyMX app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your ButterflyMX password
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} no longer works.

verify.title: Check your texts
verify.description: ButterflyMX texted a 6-digit code to the phone on the {email} account. It expires in about 2 minutes. Use "Text me a new code" if it expired or didn't arrive.

resent.title: New code sent
resent.description: A new code was just texted to the phone on the {email} account. It expires in about 2 minutes. Enter it, or use "Text me a new code" if it doesn't arrive.

enter_code.title: Enter the code
enter_code.description: Enter the 6-digit code ButterflyMX texted to the phone on the {email} account. It expires in about 2 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach ButterflyMX. Try again later.
error.invalid_code: That code wasn't accepted. Check the text and try again.
error.verification_expired: ButterflyMX didn't finish signing in after the code (it may have expired). Sign in again to get a new code; details are in the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
